description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Atuação em uma empresa de grande porte do setor financeiro , com presença nacional e internacional , em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo e orientado a dados .

Buscamos um profissional com foco em Engenharia de Dados , que possua background em desenvolvimento backend , especialmente com Node.js, Scala e Databricks , para atuar em projetos desafiadores e de alto impacto tecnológico.

title: Senior Base24 Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

Location: Brazil

Client: Fiserv

Budget: $4,500 USD as CONTRACTOR (No benefits)

Duration: Long-term

Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

This role requires strong technical depth in transaction message processing (ISO 8583) , ATM/POS terminal driving , and tuning systems for high availability and performance. The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, enhance, and support Base24 / Base24 Classic applications on HP NonStop (Tandem) platform .
  • Maintain and modify ATM/POS transaction switch modules , authorization, settlement, and device handler components.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot end-to-end transaction flows including issuer/acquirer interfaces.
  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

description:

The Structure Technician will carry out inspections, repairs, fabrication, and installation of aircraft structural components and assemblies, ensuring airworthiness and quality standards are maintained at all times.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Knowledge of structural repair manuals (SRM) and aircraft material processes.

Required Skills

  • Proven experience in sheet metal and composite repairs.
  • Skilled in fabrication, riveting, and use of precision measuring tools.
  • Familiarity with aircraft safety and quality standards.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documents.

title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.

If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.

About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.

Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.

Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.

Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.

Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.

What You’ll Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English suitable for professional U.S. business communication.
  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.
  • Experience working with US-based companies in operations and/or account/project management support.
  • Strong technology background.
  • Experience using AI to increase efficiency and automation.
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with CRM’s, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and ChatGPT or similar tools.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and take ownership.
  • A professional home office setup suitable for professional video calls with executives.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and consistent availability during U.S. business hours with Central Time schedule.

Ideal Background

  • Three to five years of experience in operations or project management roles.
  • Longevity on your resume with the ability to articulate your success in similar roles.
  • Experience supporting executives or business owners in fast-paced environments.
  • Background in healthcare or executive recruiting is preferred but not required.

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary paid in USD and based on experience.
  • Full-time remote position.
  • Central Time Schedule.
  • Performance-based growth opportunities available.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Enginee r who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Extensive experience (5+ years) working as a Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS technologies and serverless architectures;

- Experience working as a Data Engineer, with focus on Azure is valuable;

- In-depth knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, Redshift, and DynamoDB, and their capabilities for building scalable data processing systems;

- Proven expertise in designing and implementing AWS serverless architectures for large-scale data processing and storage;

- Strong programming skills in languages like Python, Java, or Scala, along with experience using SQL for data manipulation and querying;

- Hands-on experience with data integration and ETL tools, such as AWS Glue or Apache Spark, for transforming and processing data;

- English

Familiarity with data modeling techniques and data warehousing concepts, including star and snowflake schemas;

- Solid understanding of data security, access control, and compliance requirements in a data-driven environment;

- Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and the ability to collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver actionable insights;

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a detail-oriented approach to ensure data accuracy and integrity;

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment

Key responsibilities:

Design and implement an AWS Serverless DataLake architecture to efficiently handle large volumes of data and support various data processing workflows;

- Develop data ingestion pipelines and data integration processes, ensuring the smooth and reliable transfer of data from various sources into the DataLake;

- Implement data transformation and data enrichment processes using AWS Lambda, Glue, or similar serverless technologies to ensure data quality and consistency;

- Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand their data requirements and design appropriate data models and schemas in the DataLake;

- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms, leveraging AWS services such as S3, Athena, Redshift, or DynamoDB, to provide high-performance access to the data;

- Monitor and troubleshoot the DataLake infrastructure, identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, data processing errors, and other issues;

- Continuously evaluate new AWS services and technologies to enhance the DataLake architecture, improve data processing efficiency, and drive innovation;

- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data engineers, fostering their growth and ensuring adherence to best practices;

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, prioritize tasks, and deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines

Data lake, aws, spark, python

title: Analista de Compliance Sênior
description:
Quem somos?

Aqui, quem faz acontecer tem espaço pra brilhar .

Como Analista de Compliance Sênior, você será responsável por garantir que nossas operações estejam em total conformidade com a regulação brasileira, contribuindo diretamente para a estruturação e evolução da área de Compliance em um ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

A oportunidade é para atuar em uma empresa líder global em soluções transacionais, que há mais de 50 anos conecta empresas, colaboradores e comerciantes ao redor do mundo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Product Designer com forte foco em criar experiências que conectem negócios e consumidores em soluções híbridas B2B e B2C . Você será responsável por desenvolver produtos digitais centrados no usuário, equilibrando usabilidade, viabilidade técnica e valor de negócio, com atuação estratégica em pesquisa e validação de hipóteses .

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Conduzir o processo de descoberta (discovery) em parceria com Product Managers, engenheiros e stakeholders, mapeando jornadas, dores e oportunidades.
  • Planejar, executar e analisar pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas com clientes corporativos e usuários finais.
  • Transformar insights de pesquisa em soluções tangíveis — wireframes, fluxos, protótipos e testes de usabilidade .
  • Atuar em soluções híbridas (B2B e B2C) , considerando diferentes perfis de usuários, contextos e níveis de decisão.
  • Colaborar com o time de produto na definição de hipóteses, priorização e experimentação de soluções (design-driven discovery).
  • Garantir consistência visual e de experiência por meio de design systems e boas práticas de UI/UX.
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento de uma cultura de design orientada por dados e pesquisa contínua.

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Designer, UX Designer ou Service Designer , com atuação em produtos digitais.
  • Domínio de Figma e outras ferramentas de prototipagem e colaboração.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em User Research (entrevistas, testes de usabilidade, surveys e análise comportamental).
  • Capacidade de traduzir descobertas em decisões de produto claras e práticas .
  • Mentalidade data-informed , com foco em métricas de impacto (NPS, adoção, engajamento e retenção).
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade para influenciar decisões estratégicas de produto.

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência em plataformas complexas (marketplaces, SaaS, mobilidade, fintechs).
  • Familiaridade com Design Ops e gestão de Design Systems .
  • Conhecimento em experimentação e testes A/B .
  • Atuação prévia em pesquisa aplicada ou customer experience .

Onde você vai trabalhar?

Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

title: Senior Facilities Manager
description:
Primary Purpose of the Position

The Senior Facilities Manager is responsible for the strategic and operational management of the school’s facilities, ensuring a safe, functional, and efficient environment for the school community. This professional coordinates the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams, as well as the outsourced contracts for gardening and cleaning services, ensuring service quality, meeting deadlines, and controlling costs. They plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance programs, manage the department’s budget, and ensure the legal compliance of the buildings.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

  • Directly manage the maintenance, electrical, civil, and operational support teams.
  • Manage outsourced contracts for gardening, cleaning, and other related services.
  • Plan and execute the annual preventive and corrective maintenance schedule.
  • Oversee, together with the Technical Construction Consultant, large-scale projects and interventions, ensuring alignment with quality standards, deadlines, and budget.
  • Develop and control the department’s budget, including operational costs and infrastructure investments.
  • Monitor the performance of vendors and contractors, ensuring the quality and efficiency of the services provided.
  • Develop and track facilities performance indicators (KPIs), such as costs, response time, and operational availability.
  • Keep all legal and technical building documentation up to date (e.g., fire department inspection certificate, accessibility reports, and other mandatory certifications).
  • Support inspections and audits.
  • Coordinate campus support activities such as events, sports, and material movement.
  • Ensure a safe and appropriate physical environment for both academic and administrative activities.
  • Promote the efficient use of campus spaces and resources, in alignment with other school departments.
  • Lead the Facilities team, fostering people management, performance evaluation, and professional development opportunities.
  • Support the Director of Business and Operations in strategic decisions related to infrastructure and investments.
  • Maintain effective communication with various departments, including academic areas, to ensure operational alignment and support for school activities

Certifications and Education

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering

Experience

Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em gestão de facilities, manutenção predial ou áreas correlatas

Previous experience in the education sector or in complex service institutions- Desired

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Proficiency in English.

Strong leadership skills and ability to manage multidisciplinary teams.

Experience in budgeting, planning, and cost control.

Knowledge of safety, environmental, and building maintenance standards.

title: Sales Operations Specialist — Integration Solution Team
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Target Management and Performance Tracking: Assist the business leader in setting and breaking down team sales targets, establish mechanisms for goal tracking and analysis, monitor and report sales data and performance to ensure the achievement of team goals.
  2. Training Support: Plan and organize various training sessions for the sales team according to business needs, including onboarding, product knowledge, and sales skills training—driving continuous improvement of team capabilities.
  3. Culture Building & Team Atmosphere: Support the business leader in cultivating a positive team culture, organize team-building activities, experience sharing, and incentive events to enhance team cohesion and sense of belonging.
  4. Process and System Optimization: Help optimize sales operation processes and related policies, continuously improve workflow modes, and enhance team collaboration quality and efficiency.
  5. Data Analysis and Decision Support: Collect, organize, and analyze business-related data; provide business insights and reporting to support decision making and the optimization of sales strategies.
  6. Cross-Department Communication and Collaboration: Serve as a bridge between the business leader and the sales team, promote collaboration among sales, technical, product, and other teams to ensure smooth information flow and successful project delivery.
  7. Team Support and Daily Management: Provide daily support to team members, assist in solving work-related challenges, resource allocation, and task coordination, ensuring efficient team operations.

Job Requirements

  1. At least 2 years of experience in sales operations, training support, or team management; experience in B2B business, internet, or technical roles is preferred.
  2. Background in data analysis or business analysis (BA experience preferred), able to use data insights to optimize business processes and support decision making.
  3. Solid skills in target management and team service awareness, able to drive performance achievement and ongoing process optimization.

title: Computer Vision Engineer (AI & Retail Analytics)
description:
About Aravita

At Aravita, we are on a mission to solve one of the world's biggest challenges: fresh food waste. Our AI-powered platform uses intelligent forecasting and order recommendations to optimize fresh food operations, reduce overstocking, and minimize out-of-stock items. We are a passionate, innovative team looking for a new member to help us build this fresh-focused technology and be part of a positive change.

The Role

We are looking for a highly-motivated Computer Vision Engineer to join our AI team. This is a hands-on role where you will be responsible for building, training, and deploying the computer vision models at the heart of our next-generation retail analytics platform.

Your primary mission will be to analyze images from grocery store shelves to perform:

  • SKU & Planogram Recognition: understand what products are where on the shelf.
  • Quantity Estimation & Stockout Detection: accurately count or estimate product quantities and automatically detect empty spaces.

This role is perfect for a  problem-solver and a  quick learner who is obsessed with shipping code and seeing their models create real-world impact. The outputs you build will be a critical input for our core forecasting and logistics models.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build & Train: design and train deep learning models for object detection, image classification, and segmentation in a complex, real-world retail environment.
  • Critically Think & Evaluate: you won't just build—you'll analyze. You will benchmark and integrate custom models (e.g., YOLO) against third-party AI services (like Google Vertex AI and Azure AI Vision) to find the best-fit solution for the problem.
  • Master the Data: work with large, imbalanced, and often challenging image datasets and develop clever strategies for data augmentation and annotation.
  • Collaborate & Deploy: work closely with our data science and engineering teams to deploy your models into a scalable production environment.

Our Ideal Candidate...

  • Is a  problem-solver first . You are excited by a complex challenge and have the critical thinking skills to break it down.
  • Is a  fast learner . You might not know every tool on day one, but you have the fundamentals and drive to learn them quickly.
  • Is  hands-on and results-oriented . You have a bias for action and a passion for building and shipping solutions.
  • Has strong  Python skills and hands-on experience with a major ML framework like  PyTorch or  TensorFlow .
  • Has a solid understanding of computer vision principles and deep learning models (e.g., CNNs, object detection, transfer learning).

What You'll Work With (And Learn)

This is a fantastic opportunity to get hands-on experience with a state-of-the-art stack.  You don't need to be an expert in all of these today, but you should be excited to learn them.

  • Custom Models: YOLO, ResNet, and other SOTA architectures.
  • Core Toolkit: Python, OpenCV, PyTorch/TensorFlow.
  • Cloud AI Services: Google Vertex AI Vision & Azure AI Vision.
  • Emerging Tech: exploring multimodal LLMs for image analysis.
  • MLOps: production model deployment, monitoring, and versioning.

Bonus Points (Nice to Have)

  • A personal or academic portfolio of computer vision projects.
  • Experience with managed AI services from Google Cloud or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and best practices.
  • Location: candidates based in or near  São Paulo, SP , are preferred for occasional team meetups.

Aqui, valorizamos o bem-estar e o desenvolvimento das nossas pessoas. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote completo de benefícios pensado para proporcionar qualidade de vida, reconhecimento e crescimento profissional :

  • Cartão Flash: R$ 1.000,00 mensais para alimentação e refeição, com flexibilidade de uso;

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

Apenas candidatos de nível Sênior, com boa pontuação após o teste online, serão considerados como aptos para seguirem conosco.

Processo Seletivo

Todos os candidatos deverão realizar o teste técnico online na plataforma Coderbyte , com gravação de tela obrigatória durante a execução .

O teste deverá ser realizado sem acesso a qualquer ferramenta de consulta externa (como Google, ChatGPT, ou similares). A utilização de recursos externos é terminantemente proibida , tanto no teste online quanto no teste técnico presencial.

Nosso objetivo é garantir uma avaliação justa, transparente e baseada exclusivamente nos conhecimentos reais de cada candidato .

Será considerado aprovado para a próxima etapa o candidato que atingir pontuação mínima de 70% no teste Coderbyte, sem identificação de irregularidades durante a execução.

As etapas do processo seletivo incluem:

  1. Triagem inicial de perfil, competências e análise das respostas enviadas;
  2. Teste técnico online (Coderbyte) – com pontuação mínima exigida e verificação de integridade;

•Coordenar o onboardingde novos membros.

•Promover e implementar metodologias ágeis.

•Aprovar horas de acordo com o realizado do mês.

Buscamos alguém que apresente:

•Experiência como Líder Técnico ou Coordenador de Tecnologia, gerenciando equipes de desenvolvimento de software

•Experiência com governança de repositórios, ferramentas de cloud e implementação de políticas de Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de dados.

•Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, Lean) e práticas de DevOps(CI/CD, pipelines, SQL,). Conhecimento em Dados

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Job Title: DevOps Engineer

Duration: 12 months (ASAP Start)

Work Type: Hybrid (3 Days Onsite per Week)

Location: São Paulo, Brazil )

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer to design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and efficient DevOps solutions in Azure. The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) , CI/CD pipelines , and infrastructure automation , with a strong background in cloud architecture and system reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align DevOps practices with business goals.
  • Support incident , problem , and change management processes.
  • Architect, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for retail applications.
  • Deploy and manage containerized workloads using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) and Kubernetes.
  • Manage and optimize Azure infrastructure , ensuring performance, scalability, and cost-efficiency.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform , ARM templates , and scripting tools ( PowerShell , Bash , Python ).
  • Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting with Azure Monitor , Grafana , and related tools.
  • Support day-to-day DevOps operations and contribute to environment stability.
  • Develop and maintain scripts for automation and system optimization.
  • Ensure digital security, perform vulnerability management, and participate in disaster recovery planning and testing .
  • Troubleshoot networking, infrastructure, and deployment issues.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in technology with a strong focus on DevOps and cloud engineering .
  • Deep expertise in Microsoft Azure , including virtual machines, AKS, networking, storage, load balancers, and security.
  • Strong understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab).
  • Proficient in infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, ARM templates, or similar tools.
  • Solid programming experience in one or more languages: C#, Java, or Python .
  • Strong SQL and database experience (MS SQL Server, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS).
  • Skilled in scripting ( PowerShell , Bash ) and automation frameworks.
  • Experience applying modern Service Delivery methods — Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and ITIL-based processes.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with proven ability to work across teams.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices , including IAM, firewalls, and network security groups.

Desired Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert — validating expertise in designing and implementing DevOps practices on Azure.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert — demonstrating advanced Azure solution design skills.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) — validating Kubernetes deployment and management proficiency
  • Experience with retail or wholesale trading systems is a plus.

title: Reporter
description:
Risk Event-Driven Distressed (REDD) Intelligence is looking for a reporter to cover corporates in Brazil out of our office in Sao Paulo.

The reporter will have a notable track record covering and breaking news and a solid understanding of the corporate credit space, working closely with our experienced team of financial reporters and analysts to cover performing/distressed corporates in Brazil.

Day-to-day activities include:

  • Breaking news on corporate finance and operations, turnarounds and restructurings, legal, regulatory and market developments affecting Brazilian issuers
  • Working closely with our market-leading team of reporters and analysts across the global emerging markets
  • Analysis of finance, economics, legal situations and other data affecting corporates under coverage

Requirements:

  • A minimum three to five years’ experience with coverage of Brazil’s corporate space
  • A deep network of contacts in the business, asset management, banking, and legal communities
  • Knowledge of the corporate bond market and global/onshore credit
  • Facility with financial data and analysis related to coverage of the corporate space
  • Knowledge of the local dynamics affecting corporates under coverage
  • The ability to work collaboratively in a deadline-driven, fast-paced environment
  • Excellent English language writing skills

About REDD:

REDD produces real-time news and analysis on emerging market corporate and sovereign event-driven special situations, helping asset managers, bankers, and advisers assess opportunities in the high-yield and high-grade markets.

REDD is a strong proponent of gender and racial diversity, and an equal opportunity employer. We are a motivated team of free thinkers and expect our team members to be personable and dynamic, encouraging “out of the box” thinking and the ability to discuss and appreciate different points of view to avoid the blind spots presented by group think.

We can offer you an opportunity to pursue a challenging but rewarding career with ample progression within a diverse international organisation. We also offer a market-leading competitive salary package and flexible working arrangements.

Headquartered in London with bureaus across the global emerging markets, REDD Intelligence’s team is made up of professionals with investment banking, legal and financial reporting experience, leveraging regional relationships to report on catalysts related to a universe of over 3,500 companies and sovereigns under coverage.

title: Gerente de loja
description:

  • Planejar as estratégias de venda desenvolvendo ações com base em análises de mercado, sazonalidade e comportamento do cliente, buscando resultados positivos e aumento da competitividade da loja;
  • Conduzir o processo de recrutamento e seleção para cargos operacionais de loja , garantindo o alinhamento entre o perfil buscado e os valores da cia;
  • Garantir o cuidado e conservação do patrimônio da cia , promovendo a conservação dos equipamentos e recursos para a segurança do ambiente de trabalho.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Graduação Completa;
  • Conhecimento do pacote office;
  • Habilidade analítica e estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Perfil direcionado a resultados;

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

Informações adicionais

Nossos benefícios:

  • Regime CLT e benefícios abrangentes, como Vale Refeição, Plano de Saúde Bradesco e Plano Odontológico Amil;
  • Wellhub, promovendo bem-estar e qualidade de vida;
  • Seguro de vida, garantindo proteção para você e sua família;
  • Licenças estendidas: Somos uma Empresa Cidadã, com 180 dias de licença maternidade e 20 dias de licença paternidade. Um tempo a mais para cuidar de quem mais importa - nosso futuro;
  • Descontos exclusivos nas nossas lojas físicas após o período de experiência, conectando você ainda mais aos nossos produtos e serviços;
  • Plataforma interna repleta de cursos e treinamentos que impulsionam sua trajetória profissional;
  • Ambiente colaborativo e inclusivo, perfeito para ensinar, aprender e se desenvolver tanto pessoal quanto profissionalmente.

Nosso impacto vai além:

Cada dia na Americanas é uma oportunidade de transformar desafios em soluções; ideias em realizações. Estamos comprometidos em fazer a diferença, cuidando das nossas pessoas e contribuindo para um impacto positivo não só para os nossos stakeholders, mas para toda a sociedade.

Se você quer fazer parte de uma empresa que valoriza a autenticidade, a inovação e o trabalho coletivo, venha fazer parte da Americanas S.A. Aqui, crescemos juntos, resolvemos a vida de milhões e criamos histórias que inspiram.

Local de Trabalho:

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em Juara/MT.

Etapas do processo

  1. Cadastro
  2. Entrevista com área de Gente
  3. Entrevista com Gestão
  4. Proposta
  5. Contratação

Quem Somos:

Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.

Valores e Propósito:

Nosso propósito é resolver a vida das pessoas , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos .

Diversidade e inclusão:

A Americanas S.A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

title: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst

About the Role

As a key member of our Workday Application Management Support team, the Workday Recruiting and Talent Analyst will own the configuration, maintenance, and support of our Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.

You will partner closely with HR and Talent Acquisition Teams to ensure Workday solutions align with evolving business needs, legal / regulatory requirements, and employee experience goals.

This role requires deep functional expertise in Workday configuration, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate HR and Recruiting requirements into scalable Workday solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maximize the effectiveness of Workday by configuring, maintaining, and continuously optimizing Workday Recruiting, Talent, Performance, and Learning modules.
  • Enable better talent decisions and development by supporting scalable, user-friendly solutions for career growth, goal tracking, and feedback collection.
  • Enhance the candidate and employee experience by resolving issues and queries that impact usability, accuracy, or workflow across recruiting and talent modules.
  • Drive the success of the annual performance review cycle by owning the configuration, launch, monitoring, and post-cycle review of performance processes, while identifying opportunities for process and system improvements.
  • Ensure data accuracy and process scalability by preparing, loading, and validating EIBs for mass data updates.
  • Maximize system performance and adoption by evaluating new Workday releases, identifying relevant enhancements, and recommending high-impact improvements to stakeholders.
  • Ensure system reliability and business continuity by proactively monitoring health and resolving issues across Recruiting and Talent modules.
  • Improve transparency and knowledge sharing by maintaining clear, user-friendly documentation for configurations, business processes, and system policies.
  • Accelerate continuous improvement initiatives through cross-functional collaboration with analysts, IT teams, HR, Talent Acquisition and business stakeholders, delivering enhancements that add value and reduce manual effort.
  • Safeguard data integrity and compliance by ensuring configurations align with internal governance, audit requirements, and security standards.
  • Enhance user confidence and self-service adoption by contributing to the development of end-user training materials in partnership with HR.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience, with expertise in Recruiting, Talent, Performance and Learning modules.
  • Strong understanding of HR and Recruiting policies.
  • Experience with Workday business processes, security roles related to Recruiting, Talent, and change management.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Proficiency in EIBs and data management within Workday.
  • Strong communication skills with ability to translate technical configurations to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a commitment to data accuracy and process integrity.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent English.

Preferred:

  • Workday certification(s) in HCM, Recruiting, Talent, Performance or Learning.
  • Experience supporting Workday release cycles and testing activities.
  • Familiarity with Workday reporting basics, including calculated fields and report writer.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: a Kantar valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

Na Kantar IBOPE Media, a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

Todos os candidatos passarão por teste técnico online na plataforma Coderbyte, com gravação de tela obrigatória durante a execução. As etapas incluem:

Teste técnico presencial (validação prática) - cortesia de bônus no cartão Flash.

  • Benefício mantido nas férias e licença maternidade: o valor do Flash (R$ 1.000,00) continua sendo concedido;

Processo Seletivo

O teste deverá ser realizado sem acesso a qualquer ferramenta de consulta externa (como Google, ChatGPT, ou similares). A utilização de recursos externos é terminantemente proibida , tanto no teste online quanto no teste técnico presencial.

Nosso objetivo é garantir uma avaliação justa, transparente e baseada exclusivamente nos conhecimentos reais de cada candidato .

Será considerado aprovado para a próxima etapa o candidato que atingir pontuação mínima de 70% no teste Coderbyte, sem identificação de irregularidades durante a execução.

As etapas do processo seletivo incluem:

  1. Triagem inicial de perfil, competências e análise das respostas enviadas;

  3. Teste técnico presencial só para os finalistas (validação prática) – com cortesia de bônus no cartão Flash

title: Human Resources Business Partner - Commercial - Merchant Onboarding Team
description:
Who We Are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global powerhouse in the delivery industry, on an ambitious mission to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this belief, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage.

With over 1,000 employees around the world, Keeta is rapidly expanding — and you can be part of this exciting journey!

Your Responsibilities

  • Act as a strategic HR partner, supporting talent acquisition efforts and building long-term mechanisms for employee development and retention.
  • Serve as a bridge between business units and HR, ensuring alignment and collaboration to achieve organizational goals.
  • Provide internal consulting to leaders and teams, offering agile, simplified, and locally adapted HR solutions.
  • Oversee the entire employee lifecycle — from onboarding to offboarding — ensuring a consistent and positive experience.
  • Collaborate closely with the Talent Acquisition team to align attraction and selection strategies with business priorities.
  • Monitor and support performance management and organizational climate, providing data-driven insights to empower leadership decisions.
  • Identify development needs and support leaders in creating and implementing training initiatives and projects.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies, local labor laws, and diversity and inclusion practices.
  • Apply business acumen to propose improvements in organizational structure and operational efficiency.
  • Lead cultural initiatives that enhance engagement, team cohesion, and a healthy, productive work environment.
  • Act as a cultural and strategic bridge between local teams and global leadership, bringing critical insights to foster sustainable growth.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree; minimum of 5 years of experience in Human Resources roles.
  • Prior experience as an HRBP or HR Generalist in internet/technology companies is highly desirable.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory.
  • Strong analytical ability to assess organizations, propose effective structures, and lead HR initiatives in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • High sense of ownership, approachability, and ability to build trust-based relationships at all levels.
  • Work model: On-site.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working at early-stage companies in Brazil (stage 0→1), particularly in contexts of rapid growth.
  • Previous experience with Chinese companies or multicultural environments involving Asian structures and dynamics.

title: Sales Director South America (Automotive)
description:
Company Overview:

AEW Automotive is a leading international supplier of advanced engineering solutions, components, and systems for the automotive industry. With a strong commitment to innovation, quality, and customer satisfaction, AEW partners with global OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers to drive technological excellence and sustainability across the mobility sector.

As we expand our footprint in South America, we are looking for a highly motivated and entrepreneurial Sales Director to lead our business development and sales efforts in the region.

Position Overview:

The Sales Director South America will be responsible for developing and executing AEW Automotive’s go-to-market and growth strategy across Brazil and the broader South American region.

The focus will initially be on new business acquisition and strategic relationship building with automotive OEMs, Tier 1, and Tier 2 suppliers. This role requires a dynamic hunter personality with strong industry knowledge, entrepreneurial drive, and the ability to establish AEW as a trusted partner in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a regional sales and business development strategy aligned with AEW’s global objectives.
  • Identify, pursue, and close new business opportunities with OEMs, Tier 1, and Tier 2 automotive customers in South America.
  • Establish and nurture long-term customer relationships to drive sustainable growth.
  • Conduct market analysis to identify key trends, emerging technologies, and potential business partners.
  • Collaborate closely with AEW’s global engineering, product, and operations teams to tailor solutions to customer needs.
  • Manage the entire sales cycle from lead generation to contract negotiation and closure.
  • Represent AEW at industry events, trade fairs, and conferences across the region.
  • Provide regular reporting on sales performance, pipeline development, and market insights to the global leadership team.

Qualifications and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • Minimum 6+ years of experience in sales or business development within the automotive industry , ideally with international exposure.
  • Proven track record of generating new business and achieving sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of automotive supply chains and OEM/Tier 1 ecosystems in South America.
  • Excellent negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English ; Spanish is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel across South America as needed.

Personal Profile:

  • Entrepreneurial, hunter-minded sales professional with high energy and resilience.
  • Strong strategic thinker with hands-on execution capabilities.
  • Results-driven, self-motivated, and capable of working independently in a remote setup.
  • Excellent intercultural communication and collaboration skills.

title: Sales Executive - Shipyards & Shipowners
description:
Job Title: Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners

Department: Sales

Role Summary

The Sales Executive – Shipyards & Shipowners will play a key role in M&O Partners’ commercial growth by representing our suppliers’ products and services to shipyards and shipowners across the maritime and offshore sectors. Reporting directly to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore and working closely with the Sales Manager , this position focuses on identifying new business opportunities, strengthening client relationships, and supporting the successful introduction of supplier solutions to shipbuilding, conversion, and vessel maintenance projects.

The Sales Executive will engage directly with shipyards, vessel owners, and technical teams, delivering value-based proposals and ensuring M&O’s solutions are well-positioned to meet client needs and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Product & Solution Representation

  • Develop a deep understanding of the suppliers’ products and their applications within shipbuilding, repair, and conversion projects.
  • Provide technical and commercial presentations tailored to shipyards and shipowner requirements.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of supplier technologies, certifications, and industry standards.

Business Development

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities with shipyards, shipowners, and related stakeholders in the maritime and offshore markets.
  • Build and manage a pipeline of qualified prospects through proactive outreach, industry networking, and relationship building.
  • Convert leads into sales opportunities and manage the full sales process from initial contact to contract closure.
  • Expand M&O’s presence within key accounts, ensuring continuous engagement and satisfaction.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Insight

  • Monitor market trends, shipbuilding projects, fleet expansions, and dry-docking activities across the region.
  • Analyze competitors’ positioning, pricing, and service offerings to identify differentiation opportunities.
  • Share market insights and customer feedback with internal teams and supplier partners to guide strategic decisions.

Sales Strategy & Reporting

  • Support the development and execution of sales strategies aligned with M&O’s objectives in the marine and offshore sectors.
  • Maintain accurate records of opportunities, client interactions, and pipeline status within the CRM system.
  • Provide regular reports on sales activities, forecasts, and market developments to the Director of Sales – Marine & Offshore.

Skills and Competencies

  • B2B Sales Expertise: Proven track record in technical, industrial, or maritime sales.
  • Client Relationship Management: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and long-term partnerships with shipyards, shipowners, and technical teams.
  • Technical & Market Knowledge: Understanding of marine equipment, systems, or components used in shipbuilding and vessel maintenance.
  • Negotiation & Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing bids, pricing discussions, and contract finalization processes.
  • Strategic Thinking: Capable of identifying business opportunities through market analysis and strategic planning.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver value-driven commercial solutions.

Experience Requirements

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in B2B technical or industrial sales, preferably within the maritime, shipbuilding, or offshore sectors.
  • Experience managing relationships with shipyards, vessel owners, or marine equipment suppliers .
  • Familiarity with procurement processes and technical specifications for marine and offshore projects.
  • Background in mechanical, electrical, or marine engineering is a plus.

title: Programa Summer Experience | Estágio
description:
Agora é a sua vez!

O Tereos Summer Experience, programa de estágio de férias da Tereos, oferece a estudantes de ensino superior a oportunidade de vivenciar os desafios reais de uma das líderes do agronegócio no início de suas carreiras.

Durante o programa, você poderá desenvolver habilidades práticas enquanto encara os desafios reais de uma multinacional.

Comece hoje a cultivar o futuro que você deseja!

OBJETIVO

Preparar estudantes de ensino superior para enfrentar os desafios atuais do setor sucroenergético com objetivo de desenvolver habilidades técnicas e comportamentais para a sua profissão e conhecer na prática sua área de atuação, de forma sustentável, com orientação de supervisores, proporcionando aprendizado e experiência.

PROGRAMA DE DESENVOLVIMENTO

Nosso programa de estágio de férias oferece mais que uma experiência profissional: desenvolve na prática o universitário em um dos setores mais importantes da economia brasileira, o sucroenergético.

Aqui, você poderá conhecer sua área de atuação de maneira supervisionada.

Duração: 45 dias (jan/26 a fev/26)

O programa é organizado em 45 dias com o desafio de desenvolver um projeto focado na sua área de atuação.

Localidades: Olímpia, Tanabi, Guaíra, Colina, Guaraci e Pitangueiras.

O Tereos Summer Experience oferece oportunidades aos estudantes com uma dose extra de energia e queiram cultivar um futuro brilhante. Os requisitos para embarcar nessa jornada são:

  • Estar cursando a partir do terceiro período do ensino superior;
  • Domínio das ferramentas de informática;
  • Disponibilidade de estagiar presencialmente 6h por dia, de segunda a sexta;
  • Disponibilidade para residir durante 45 dias na região da atuação.

title: Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations
description:
Latin America Finance Business Partner - Sales & Marketing and Field Operations

Role Overview:

We are seeking a proactive, dynamic and hands-on Finance Business Partner to support our Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams across the Latin America region. This is a high-impact role where you will play a critical part in driving business performance, offering strategic financial insights, and providing actionable recommendations to enable growth and operational efficiency. You will be the key finance partner for these teams, working closely with Latam senior leadership to track field and sales performance, and ensure that business goals are met within budget.

On a typical day you will:

  • Strategic Financial Partnering: Serve as a trusted partner to Sales & Marketing and Field Operations teams, working on the databases and providing financial insights that drive decision-making and support business strategies.
  • Budgeting & Forecasting: Lead the budgeting and forecasting process for Sales & Marketing and Field Operations organizations. Develop and maintain rolling forecasts, track budget variances, and ensure financial targets are aligned with operational goals.
  • Business Performance Analysis: Analyze financial data and key performance metrics for both Sales & Marketing and Field Operations. Provide insights into revenue generation, profitability, and cost control, helping to optimize spending and improve financial outcomes.
  • Cost Management & Efficiency: Collaborate with operational leaders to identify areas for cost reduction, process improvements, and operational efficiencies within the sales and field operations domains.
  • Financial Reporting: Prepare regular financial reports and presentations for senior management, highlighting key trends, risks, and opportunities in the business. Present clear, actionable recommendations based on financial analysis.
  • KPIs and Metrics: Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor the success of sales and marketing campaigns and field operations. Ensure alignment with business objectives and provide actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with world headquarters in Finance, Sales & Marketing, and Field Operations, fostering collaboration and ensuring alignment between financial and operational goals.
  • Ad Hoc Financial Support: Provide ad-hoc financial analysis and support as needed for special projects, strategic initiatives, and decision-making processes.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Accounting, Economics or Engineering (MBA or professional finance qualification preferred).
  • Fluent English and Spanish. Strong interaction with Latin America countries and headquarters in the United States, through conference calls and in person meetings.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in managerial roles as finance business partnering, and/or financial planning & analysis, ideally with experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Operations environments.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex financial data, draw insights, and make strategic recommendations.
  • Business Acumen: Understanding of sales, marketing, and field operations metrics and the ability to translate these into actionable financial strategies.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to present complex financial data in a clear and compelling way to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Advanced Excel skills (including financial modeling) and Hyperion Financial Management (HFM) Oracle Hyperion Financial Management.
  • Collaboration: Proven ability to work cross-functionally with various business units and senior leadership to influence decision-making.
  • Problem Solving: Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities, with a proactive approach to identifying financial trends and issues.

Apply today to join us and Build What’s Next!

title: OneStream Support Analyst
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!

Buscamos: OneStream Support Analyst

Job Purpose

Responsible for carrying out OneStream EPM platform maintenance and support. OneStream provides Media with Group consolidation, reporting, and planning functionality. Maintain data integrity and support key finance processes by managing configurations, integrations and user support.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Maintenance

  • Carry out system administration and maintenance activities (users, security, workflows, metadata).
  • Maintain/deploy metadata: entities, accounts, UD dimensions, currencies and hierarchy integrity.
  • Provide user support / trouble shoot data loads, mapping/transformation rules, and validations.
  • Conduct regression testing for OneStream upgrade process.
  • Collaborate with ERP (D365) teams on data interfaces and mapping logic.
  • Liaise with Finance users, IT and project stakeholders.

Platform Development

  • Development of OneStream dashboards, cube views, and Excel Add-In reports.
  • Build and maintain VB.NET business rules, member formulas, and automation logic.

User Support

  • Troubleshooting / support finance with month-end close, consolidation, reporting and audit cycles.
  • Support end user training.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Minimum 2 - 4 years hands-on experience with OneStream (admin/config/development).
  • Strong proficiency in VB.NET skills (business rules, member formulas, automation).
  • Solid understanding of OneStream consolidation, eliminations, and currency translation processes.
  • Experience in Budgeting & Forecasting with a good grasp of finance data structures, data migration and integration workflows.
  • Proven experience with ERP integrations eg REST APIs, Flat file exchanges, or direct connectors.
  • Advanced Excel and OneStream Excel Add-In skills.
  • Analytical mindset with high attention to detail and problem solving capabilities.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across finance and technical and teams.
  • Fluent English.

Desirable

  • SQL, API, or ETL knowledge.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O.
  • Experience with OneStream Marketplace solutions (Task Manager, People Planning, Account Reconciliations).
  • OneStream certification (OCP).

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos

  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, ginastica laboral com profissional de educação física toda semana, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

title: Integration Solution-Team Leader
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.

Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management & Goal Achievement: Oversee daily operations and team management of the integration solution group, allocate resources reasonably, and lead the team to achieve goals in system integration, product optimization, and customer support.
  2. Integration Project Coordination & Delivery: Lead the planning, implementation, and delivery of integration projects involving external API service providers, hardware devices (such as printers), and internal systems, ensuring compliant and efficient execution.
  3. Technical Solution Design & Optimization: Analyze customer and business needs, coordinate with technical teams to implement system connectivity, process optimization, and new feature development, continuously improving the quality and stability of overall integration solutions.
  4. Quality & Process Control: Establish and optimize team collaboration, product testing, launch processes, and integration standards; monitor key indicators to ensure high-standard deliverables.
  5. Complex Problem Solving & Technical Challenges: Lead the team to analyze and resolve complex technical issues in project integration and device operation, promote targeted technical solutions, and ensure successful client implementation.
  6. Cross-Departmental Communication & Collaboration: Act as the core liaison within the team, work closely with sales, technical, product, and operation teams to coordinate project progress and improve business synergy.
  7. Team Development & Capability Building: Develop and organize systematic training and growth plans for team members, continuously identify and cultivate talents, and build a high-performing and cohesive team.
  8. Industry Trend Insights & Innovation: Stay updated on order-taking solution development in the restaurant/merchant industry, including APIs, hardware, and apps; drive innovation in integration solutions and lead the professional advancement of the team.

Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in Computer Science, Information Management, E-commerce, or related fields.
  2. At least 3 years of experience in technical integration, system implementation, product operations, or related team management, with a preference for experience in large-scale API, hardware, or integrated solution project management.
  3. Strong technical solution analysis, design, and optimization abilities; able to systematically solve complex technical and business problems.
  4. Familiar with API interfaces, hardware products (such as printers), apps, and various integration methods; deep understanding of overall solutions for the merchant industry is a plus.
  5. Outstanding cross-team communication, coordination, and project management skills; able to drive collaboration and achieve project goals.
  6. Ability to organize team training and development, nurture talent, and build a high-performing team.
  7. Results-oriented, highly resilient, and self-driven, with awareness of process optimization and high-standard quality control.
  8. Native-level Portuguese and strong proficiency in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing); able to communicate efficiently in an international and diverse environment. 9.Experience in restaurant/merchant integration projects or industry solution operations is a plus.

Job Highlights

  1. Early-Stage Business: Opportunity to participate in early-stage planning, design, and implementation of team and projects, driving core technology and product innovation.
  2. International Team: Work with colleagues from 26 countries, experience a diverse and open work environment, and expand your global perspective.

  • Ter conhecimento em estruturação e organização (para melhor processamento e assertividade) de bases de conhecimento para consumo da IA.
  • Avaliação da qualidade das respostas geradas por prompts e refinamento contínuo dos conteúdos.

3. Conhecimento de Ferramentas e Integrações

  • Ter conhecimento para ajustar e interpretar integrações entre essas ferramentas.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com ambientes híbridos e/ou completamente regidos por LLM
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de automação(ex:. ERPs, ITSM, CRM)
  • Ter conhecimento básico de Java Script e JSON

4. Gestão do Conhecimento e Treinamento

  • Ter conhecimento de criação de documentação clara e prática sobre configuração e uso das soluções implantadas .
  • Estudo e testes de novas abordagens alinhadas ao time de produto

5. UX Conversacional & Design de Interação

  • Garantir que as soluções de IA ofereçam interações naturais, intuitivas e eficazes. Conhecimento em análise de logs e feedbacks de usuário.
  • Experiência em design de conversas e fluxos e jornadas conversacionais.

6. Análise de Dados & Dashboards

  • Capacidade de interpretar dados de utilização métricas de engajamento e retenção e satisfação
  • Ter conhecimento em ferramentas de BI e dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Kibana).

  • Traçar planos de ação estratégicos, garantindo que o chatbot evolua de acordo com as necessidades do cliente.
  • Acompanhar a performance da IA do cliente, sugerindo ajustes contínuos.

7. Relacionamento e Atendimento ao Cliente

  • Apresentar relatórios analíticos sobre utilização da solução e planos de ação com insights estratégicos
  • Coletar feedbacks e traduzir as necessidades do cliente em melhorias na solução.
  • Capacidade de comunicar insights técnicos e estratégicos de forma clara. Experiência na apresentação de relatórios e sugestões de melhoria.

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote

Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at

As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.

Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.

Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.

Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.

Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.
